constraints: Use human gene sets only — the data is Homo sapiens skin

steps.description: Take the complete limma-trend result table from T1S2 and run a rank-based gene set enrichment (fgsea) on all tested genes ranked by the moderated t-statistic — using the full ranking rather than a thresholded list is important at n=6 per group, where the significant set may be small. Enrichment tables written with NES, p-value, BH-adjusted p-value, set size and leading-edge genes, for both directions
Redundant nested GO-BP terms are collapsed before any count is reported, with the collapsing rule stated

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM (limma-trend)
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a gene-level TPM matrix only (12,000 genes x 12 samples, /data/inputs/abundance/tpm.csv, first column gene symbol) with a 12-row metadata table giving condition (6 lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch). No raw counts and no Salmon quant directories were delivered, so count-based negative-binomial models (DESeq2, edgeR) are NOT applicable — their dispersion estimation requires integer counts and library sizes, and rounding TPM into pseudo-counts fabricates a count scale that never existed and produces anticonservative p-values. The defensible route on TPM is a log-scale linear model with empirical Bayes moderation: log2(TPM+1) with limma-trend (eBayes(trend=TRUE)), which is designed for a log-CPM/log-TPM-like input where the mean-variance relationship is handled by a fitted trend rather than by observation weights derived from counts. voom is deliberately not used because it needs library sizes and counts.

T1S1 does the QC and normalization that must precede any test: verify the TPM column sums (Salmon gene-level TPM should sum to ~1e6 per sample; deviation means the matrix was subset — 12,000 genes strongly suggests it was, which changes what 'TPM' means and must be reported), check for duplicated gene symbols and collapse them, filter to genes expressed above a low TPM floor in at least the size of the smaller group (n=6), optionally quantile-normalize log2(TPM+1) across samples to remove residual composition differences, and produce sample-level diagnostics (PCA, correlation heatmap, per-sample distributions) that reveal outliers or a hidden batch structure that the metadata does not name. T1S2 runs the DE contrast lesional vs control with limma-trend on the filtered matrix and reports the full result table with BH-adjusted p-values, plus an explicitly-labelled sanity check against the canonical psoriasis markers (DEFB4A, S100A7/A8/A9, IL36G, KRT6A/16/17, SERPINB3/4, CXCL9/10/11, IL17-axis genes) — these are not a hypothesis being tested but a positive control for whether the pipeline recovers known biology. T1S3 takes the ranked statistic and runs pathway enrichment against the staged human hallmark and GO-BP gene sets (confirmed present at /mnt/refs/managed/msigdb-*), which contextualizes the gene list without adding a claim.

Power is the honest limitation: 6 vs 6 with a 12,000-gene search space detects only large effects, and the TPM-only input means the analysis is one step less rigorous than the same experiment with counts. Both facts must appear in the reported output rather than in a footnote.
